_comment: SHA-256 of every legal document version, normalised for whitespace, excluding reviewNote. DO NOT edit an existing entry to make a test pass — a changed hash means the text of a document was altered, which is the failure this file exists to prevent. To change a document that people ACCEPT (terms, ownerAgreement): add a NEW version, freeze the old text in legal/frozen.ts, and add the new hash here. The privacy policy has no acceptance record and so no version scheme; changing its hash here is the deliberate act that makes the edit visible in review.
